protocol_metadata.about: Yearn Curating is Yearn Finance's risk-curator service, operating primarily as a curator on Morpho Blue vaults across Ethereum, Base, Katana, and Arbitrum. Users deposit assets into Yearn-curated Morpho ERC-4626 vaults where Yearn's SAM (Security and Monitoring) team manages market selection, supply-cap calculation, and automated hourly reallocation using constrained mathematical optimization. Vaults are organized into three risk tiers (Yearn, Yearn OG, Yearn Degen) reflecting the risk appetite of the underlying Morpho markets selected. Yearn also curates Term Finance vaults, where deposited assets are allocated into Yearn V3 vaults and made available for fixed-rate borrowing.
